prompt: The Observer pattern is best described as…
choices: An object wrapping another to add behaviour
A one-to-many dependency where all dependents are notified of state changes
A class that controls access to another object
An algorithm family where each variant is encapsulated
explanation: Observer (also called publish-subscribe) lets multiple observers register on a subject. When the subject changes, it notifies all observers automatically. Used in event systems, GUI listeners, and reactive programming.
